gp.message:
================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO NA AFTER EFFECTS - NU YEYEWO
Version 9.2.8  -  Oktoba 2026
================================================================================

Panel la le gbegbɔgblɔ 132 gblɔm fifia, DEMON SLAYER THEME yeyewo li siwo me yi aɖe le
button siwo nètia la ƒom, eye Layout kple Windows ŋuti ɖɔɖɔ aɖewo hã li.

DO ŊGƆ NA NÈDZE EGƆME
- Wɔ install ɖe wò version si le fifia la dzi kple wò ZXP installer si nèzãna, emegbe
  tu After Effects eye ʋu gbugbɔ zi ɖeka.
- Wò settings, theme, presets kple expressions siwo nèŋlɔ ɖi la anɔ anyi.

YEYE: PANEL LA LE GBEGBƆGBLƆ 132 ME
- Flex Settings > LANGUAGE fiaa gbegbɔgblɔ 132 fifia, kple didi ƒe aɖaka. Tia
  ɖeka eye panel blibo la atrɔ: tabs, buttons, tooltips, gbedasiwo.
- Wotrɔ gbe ɖesiaɖe tso Eŋlisigbe panel la me kple AI, menye nya
  ɖekaɖeka o. Ŋkɔ siwo nèkpɔna le wò project me (layer ŋkɔwo, effect ŋkɔwo) anɔ Eŋlisigbe me,
  ale be woanɔ ƒoƒo ɖekae kple After Effects.
- Wotrɔ "nu yeyewo" popup la hã gbe, tso release sia dzi dze egɔme.

YEYE: DEMON SLAYER THEMES
- Flex Settings > THEME SELECTOR me DEMON SLAYER ƒuƒoƒo yeye aɖe le, si me theme 11 le:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen kple Kokushibo.
- Ɖe mouse la ɖe panel la dzi eye theme la ƒe nu aɖe ato eyome: tsi, dzo,
  lightning, butterflies, petals, mist kple bubuwo. Ne mouse la tɔ la,
  ebua bɔbɔe.
- Tia button aɖe eye character ma ƒe yi aƒo button la. Ne nèlé miame ƒe button la
  ɖe te la, aƒo edzi; ne nèlé ɖe te ɣeyiɣi si ɖo sekend 2.5 ŋu la, explosion dzɔna.
- Wowɔe be wòanɔ bɔbɔe: effects la dɔa wɔ ne nèʋuʋu mouse la alo nètia nu ko, eye
  wo ŋutɔwo lé bɔbɔe wu le kɔmpiuta siwo le blewu dzi. Dzudzɔ AMBIENT EFFECTS
  le Theme Selector me be amadedewo ko nanɔ anyi.

TRƆTRƆ: FLAT BUTTONS LE THEME ESIAME ME
- Active kple main buttons le amadede theme siwo me la megazãna shaded gradient si tso dzi
  yia anyi o. Wonye flat amadede ɖeka kple kekeli bɔbɔe, eyata wokpɔna
  dzadzɛ wu eye woxlẽna bɔbɔe wu.

NU SIWO WOƉƆ
- License card kple "nu yeyewo" popup la ate ŋu aʋu ɖe wo nɔewo dzi. Fifia
  womeɖea wo nɔewo dzi gbeɖe o, eye UPDATE badge la megaɖea buttons siwo le panel la
  ƒe dzi o.
- Le UI SCALE 125% kple 150% dzi la, window aɖewo (abe Flex Settings ene) ate ŋu
  akɔkɔ wu panel la, ale be wo close button bu ɖa le nukpɔkpɔ me. Window ɖesiaɖe
  sɔna le lolome ɖesiaɖe me fifia.
- Windows: AutoCaptions ate ŋu agblɔ be "NVIDIA DRIVER LA XOXO WU NA GPU
  CAPTIONS" le card kple driver yeyewo dzi (RTX 40 kple 50 series). Fifia exlẽa
  driver la ƒe CUDA support nyuie eye ezãa wò GPU.

SI MEGATRƆ O
- License, activation kple link ɖesiaɖe wɔa dɔ abe do ŋgɔ ene tututu.
- Tab kple tool bubu ɖesiaɖe wɔa dɔ abe le 9.2.7 me ene tututu.
================================================================================

ult.message:
FLEX ULTIMATE NA PREMIERE PRO - NU YEYEWO
Version 2.2.8  -  Oktoba 2026

CAPTION STACK ƒe captions nye EDITABLE Motion Graphics templates fifia kple editor vavã,
AUDIO STUDIO yeye kple MARK AUDIO BEATS li, panel la le gbegbɔgblɔ 132 gblɔm,
UI SCALE va ULTIMATE hã me, eye DEMON SLAYER THEME yeyewo hã li.

DO ŊGƆ NA NÈDZE EGƆME
- Wɔ install ɖe wò version si le fifia la dzi kple wò ZXP installer si nèzãna, emegbe
  tu Premiere Pro eye ʋu gbugbɔ zi ɖeka.
- Wò settings, theme kple presets la anɔ anyi.

YEYE: CAPTION STACK - EDITABLE CAPTIONS (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Fifia woɖoa captions ɖe anyi abe editable Motion Graphics templates ene (Output >
  EDITABLE MOGRT, default yeye le Premiere Pro 2026 me). Ne woɖoe ɖe anyi vɔ la, àte ŋu atrɔ nya ɖesiaɖe, font,
  amadede, lolome, teƒe, glow, outline, box, animation alo timing
  le Premiere ƒe Essential Graphics panel me.
- Output > IMAGES gakpɔtɔ ɖoa nya ɖesiaɖe ɖe anyi abe nɔnɔmetata ene kple nɔnɔme ɖeka tututu,
  ne eyae nèlɔ̃ wu.
- Templates la va kple panel la. Nu aɖeke meli be nàdownload o.

YEYE: CAPTION STACK EDITOR
- Preview la fia wò video la ƒe frame vavã le caption ɖesiaɖe te fifia.
- He caption aɖe be nàʋui, zã corner la be nàtrɔ lolome, kple dot si le dzi la be nàrotate
  caption la, double-click nya aɖe be nàɖɔe. WHOLE CAPTION ʋua nya katã ɖekae,
  ONE WORD ʋua nya ɖeka koe.
- Tia be tɔtrɔ la axɔ caption ɖesiaɖe alo caption sia koe, eye
  ŋlɔ wò layouts ɖi be nàzãe ake.
- GLOW looks yeye 10: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow kple Superb.

YEYE: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Tia audio clip aɖe, tia effect aɖe eye nàtia APPLY. Nu sia nu wɔa dɔ le
  wò kɔmpiuta dzi.
- Presets 30 siwo nàwɔ ŋu kple click ɖeka: Underwater, Bass Boost, Room / Hall / Cathedral /
  Plate reverb, Echo, Telephone, Radio, Megaphone, Robot, Chipmunk, Deep
  Voice, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse kple bubuwo. Tsɔ effects
  geɖe abe ale si nèdi ene ƒo ƒu, trɔ woƒe ɖoɖo alo dzudzɔ ɖeka.
- Reverb la ɖoa eƒe tail: audio la gakpɔtɔ nɔa ɣli ɖom le clip la ƒe nuwuwu megbe, eye
  woɖoe ɖe teƒe ale be womaŋlɔ nu aɖeke si le wò timeline dzi ɖe edzi o.
- Tools: Noise Remover, Voice Enhance, Loudness (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Hum Remover, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Speed
  kple Pitch, Noise Gate, Extract Audio.
- STEMS MAKER maa ha aɖe ɖe vocals kple music (alo stems 4) me. Edownloadna eƒe model
  zi gbãtɔ, eye ebiaa wò gbã.
- PREVIEW na nèse abe sekend 8 ene kple Original / Processed switch.
  Nusi dzɔ la yia audio track si me nu aɖeke mele o dzi, eye wotua wò clip gbãtɔ ƒe ɣli,
  womeɖea ɖa gbeɖe o.

YEYE: MARK AUDIO BEATS (FX & ADV RIGS > MARK AUDIO BEATS)
- Tia music clip aɖe le timeline dzi eye nàtia MARK BEATS: Flex kpɔa beats la
  eye wòdea sequence markers wo dzi, ale be wò cuts nasɔ kple
  music la tututu.
- Tia ALL hits, KICKS alo SNARES, ɖo sensitivity, eye nàmark beat ɖesiaɖe alo
  beat evelia alo enelia ɖesiaɖe.
- REMOVE BEAT MARKERS ɖea markers siwo Flex de ko ɖa. Wɔa dɔ le
  wò kɔmpiuta dzi.

YEYE: PANEL LA LE GBEGBƆGBLƆ 132 ME
